authoring_instructions:
Create a production 2D isometric RPG sprite atlas on a real transparent RGBA background, derived from the attached exact original character. This is a sprite asset, no scene, no ground, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows. Layout EXACTLY 8 equal columns by 5 equal rows = 40 distinct full-body sprites, wide landscape image. Leave large transparent gutters and clear outer margin: every body and all weapons/legs/wings wholly inside its cell, no neighboring pieces overlap. Camera always fixed elevated 3/4 isometric, consistent size and ground-contact level. Eight columns are unique actual rotated viewpoints in this exact order: 1 EAST head points screen-right pure side, 2 SOUTHEAST head points lower-right front 3/4, 3 SOUTH head points screen-bottom front view, 4 SOUTHWEST head points lower-left front 3/4, 5 WEST head points screen-left pure side, 6 NORTHWEST head points upper-left rear 3/4, 7 NORTH head points screen-top full rear view, 8 NORTHEAST head points upper-right rear 3/4. Do not repeat diagonal views in the side or rear columns. Each row repeats that complete rotation with a different motion phase. Row1 idle neutral. Row2 idle small articulated breathing/limb/wing adjustment, not a translated duplicate. Row3 walking step A, row4 walking passing step, row5 opposite walking step B; walking must articulate actual joints and limbs/wing or sword tilt according to anatomy while keeping a stable contact reference. No attacks or death in this atlas. All 40 sprites visually distinct. Single connected character per cell, no disconnected fragments. Keep fine painted classic RPG sprite detail and original material/color identity. Match exactly the source's pale grey/silver CROCODILE: very long low armored scaly body with dorsal ridges, wide toothy snout and red inner mouth, four short splayed clawed legs, and a long tapered segmented tail. No new horns, no wings, no humanoid torso. Keep belly near ground, paws grounded. In every direction head points forward and tail trails behind.
